title: Retail Head
description: IC/PM People Manager Role Company Profile Jaquar Group is a prominent Indian conglomerate established in 1960 that operates in the bathroom and lighting industry headquartered in Manesar and has a global presence with manufacturing facilities, subsidiaries, and distribution networks in various countries. Jaquar has grown to become one of the leading manufacturers of premium bathroom fittings, sanitary ware, faucets, showers, wellness products, and lighting solutions. Our Values At Jaquar Group, our values guide everything we do. As part of our team, you will be expected to uphold these principles: Passion for technology – We innovate continuously Highest quality standards – We strive for excellence Building strong relationships – We value lasting partnerships Excellent customer service – We prioritize customer satisfaction Taking care of our people – We support and nurture our team Integrity – We uphold the highest ethical standards About the Role The Head - Retail is responsible for driving the retail sales performance of Jaquar's diverse product portfolio, including faucets, cisterns, sanitaryware, HWS, shower enclosures, wellness products, and premium lighting segments. This role involves leading and developing the retail sales team, ensuring revenue targets are met, expanding the dealer network, and achieving growth targets. The Branch Head - Retail acts as a key brand ambassador, fostering relationships with top dealers and driving market development activities to enhance brand visibility and market share. Key Responsibilities 1. Retail Sales Team Management Ensure the retail sales team performs in line with their defined KRAs Monitor, guide, and support the team to achieve individual and collective sales targets Provide training and support to optimize team productivity and sales effectiveness 2. Revenue Performance Achieve sales targets for all retail product categories, including faucets, cisterns, sanitaryware, HWS, shower enclosures, wellness products, and premium lighting segments Monitor and drive revenue growth across these product lines to meet overall business objectives 3. Retail Business Growth Ensure that at least 85% of the dealer network shows growth and enhance market coverage Develop strategies to attract and expand the dealer network 4. Director Club Dealers CBLS Targets Attain CBLS targets with Director Club dealers, fostering strong relationships and ensuring mutual growth and success Foster strong relationships with top-performing dealers to ensure their continued growth and engagement 5. Market Analysis and Strategy Conduct market analysis to identify trends and opportunities for improvement Implement strategies based on market insights to drive business growth 6. Operational Excellence Ensure seamless daily operations of the retail branch, including inventory management, store layout optimization, and customer service excellence Oversee the implementation of operational procedures and ensure compliance with company standards and policies 7. Customer Relationship Management Develop and implement strategies to enhance customer satisfaction and loyalty Address and resolve customer complaints and issues promptly, ensuring a high level of service 8. Sales and Marketing Initiatives Lead and execute marketing and promotional activities to increase brand awareness and drive foot traffic to the retail branch Collaborate with the marketing team to develop campaigns tailored to local market needs 9. Financial Management Monitor branch financial performance, including budgeting, forecasting, and cost control. Ensure efficient use of resources and maintain profitability targets. 10. Sales Operations Implement ROI-based strategies to drive consistent sales growth across all channels Facilitate coordination between ADs and RDs to enhance market services in alignment with company standards. Ensure active participation of ADs in market development activities Play an active role in implementing Visual Merchandising (VM) initiatives such as JDS (Jaquar Display Showroom), ADS (Artize Display Showroom), and EDS (Essco Display Showroom) to ensure seamless coordination on the ground Key Attributes Proven experience in managing and growing retail sales teams Expertise in market development and dealer network expansion Strong leadership skills with a track record of achieving sales targets Ability to analyze market trends and adapt strategies accordingly Experience in enhancing brand visibility and market presence Competencies Customer Focus Negotiation Skills Presentation Skills Competitor Analysis and Market Development Qualifications and Experience Education: Graduate degree in Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred Additional certifications in sales or marketing are a plus Experience: 15-18 years in the building material industry, with a minimum of 3-4 years in a leadership role managing retail sales and teams Skills: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills Strong negotiation and problem-solving abilities Effective planning, organizational, and strategic thinking skills Proactive and results-oriented approach Ability to build and maintain strong relationships with dealers and customers Adaptability to evolving market conditions and challenges Company Commitment to Equal Opportunity Employment Jaquar Group is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, national orientation or disability.
